|game1= arma3

|gr1= Lights

|eff= local

|descr= Sets if light has flare.

{{Note
|user= ffur2007slx2_5
|timestamp= 20140325185000
|text= <nowiki/>
# In {{arma3}} ver 1.14 flare color can be changed via [[setLightColor]].
# Flare won't have visual presentation in daytime.
# [[setLightUseFlare]] needs to be used together with [[setLightFlareSize]] and [[setLightFlareMaxDistance]] so that a flare can be seen.
}}
